# Development-only dependencies for rebuilding tests/fixtures/*.pdf:
#
#     pip install -r tests/requirements.txt
#     python3 tests/generate_fixtures.py
#
# The Cangjie library itself has no Python dependency; nothing here is needed
# to build or run pdf4cj.
#
# reportlab generates the reportlab-based fixtures (and its `invariant` mode is
# what makes them deterministic), Pillow produces the PNG/JPEG payloads. Pin
# both if you need the regenerated bytes to match a specific commit - reportlab
# decides the internal image XObject names, so its version is part of the
# fixture's bytes.
reportlab>=5.0
Pillow>=12
